title: Does giving the extractor an ontology make two models agree?
question: Holding documents, prompt, chunking and seed fixed, does the schema handed to the extractor change how often two models describe the same fact under the same name?
hypothesis: Pre-registered: agreement rises from no ontology, through the hand-written schema, to real FIBO, and highest with the synonym layer. More shared vocabulary, more shared naming.
still_needed: a confidence interval, before any difference is stated as a result
a correctness measure, since a schema could lower agreement and raise accuracy
a content measure, since agreement on names is not agreement on facts
